newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo-Russia sign $2 mln construction deal-Tanjug.
newsitem.headline: Yugo-Russia sign $2 mln construction deal-Tanjug.

text.p: Yugoslavia's Belgrade-based construction company Mostogradnja and Moscow city authorities have signed a $2 million deal for the reconstruction of a bridge in Moscow, state news agency Tanjug said Wednesday.
"The reconstruction of the bridge has already started and under the contract should be completed by August 10," Mostogradnja director Milovan Krstajic was quoted as saying.
The deal was concluded within the scope of a project to reconstruct bridges in and around Moscow financed by the World Bank with around $500 million, he said.
Mostogradnja registered a total revenue of 140 million dinars last year and plans to exceed it by 40 percent this year, Krstajic said. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
